questions.prompt: Which type stores a true/false value?

questions.explanation: `public` and `private` control access. `static` controls ownership; `final` prevents reassignment or extension.

questions.prompt: Write a complete `Main` program that reads two integers and prints their sum.
questions.explanation: Read both values, add them, then print the sum.
questions.reference: public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { java.util.Scanner s = new java.util.Scanner(System.in); System.out.println(s.nextInt() + s.nextInt()); } }

questions.prompt: Complete `square(int n)` by writing its method body.
questions.explanation: Multiplying an integer by itself gives its square.

# Keep both sides balanced

Apply the same operation to both sides of an equation.

For `3x + 2 = 14`, subtract 2 and divide by 3.

title: Cells and molecules
description: Review a few building blocks of biology and chemistry.
subject: Science

lessons.title: Start here
lessons.markdown:
# From molecules to cells

Water is **H₂O**: two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

Human cells have specialized structures. The nucleus stores most genetic information.

tests.title: Cells and molecules practice
tests.description: A short original practice set with immediate explanations.

questions.prompt: Which structure contains most of a human cell’s genetic material?
questions.explanation: The nucleus holds most DNA in human cells. Mitochondria also contain a small amount.

questions.prompt: What is the chemical formula for water?
questions.explanation: Water contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
